title: Unit 408 hallway: three Opus directions (HD, HE, HF)
overview: Three more hallway directions for Unit 408 around the same fixed idea: the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203 hung at true scale (104 x 65 cm, bottom edge at 1.1 m) on the plain wall over a solid floor-standing dresser with six or more drawers whose top holds photos and keepsakes. In this set the map is centred 2.87 m from the living end so it clears the light switch near the living end. D Harbour Grey, the premium build (grey grooved lacquer, navy art glass, a chrome picture-light bar, a black-and-white rug, a slender grey-green tree), E Conservatory Sage, the value build (a sage-painted map wall, smoked-oak shaker drawers, woven sedge wall lamps, a green-grid rug, a bird-of-paradise) and F Charcoal Gallery, mid-price (a charcoal map wall, an espresso eight-drawer dresser, an amber-glass cube lamp, black gallery spots, a tall black mirror). Fixed in all three: both arches dark, the honey-amber parquet, Davies Beige blackout and voile with valance boards on the window run, no hallway aircon, no added ceiling light. The wall lights and wall paint are proposals; hallway lighting is still undecided. Nothing in the hallway is measured: conditional fit; hallway unmeasured.
requirements: Three distinct hallway sets with the same wall composition: the owner's LEGO Art World Map 31203 at true scale (1040 x 650, bottom at 1100) over a solid floor-standing dresser with six or more drawers and a display top. No model or family repeats across the schemes, the Fable hallway sets (A, B, C and H), the Astra hallway set or the other rooms' claims.

Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: the ceiling, the corridor width and length, both arches, the window run and the light switch position are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md); every plan and view depends on them until the tape numbers arrive.

The dressers, lamps, rugs, plants, the mirror and the wall lights are real catalogue products with a supplier photo, price and source link; the map is owner-supplied at nil and the wall paint (E, F) is a planning allowance, not a product.

Kept in every scheme: both arches dark, the parquet throughout, Davies Beige blackout + voile with valance boards on the window run (Seoul Blinds offer, priced in the curtain quote, not here), no hallway aircon, no added ceiling light; the wall lights are plug-in proposals, labelled as proposals.
procurement_gates: Prices are frozen 20 Oct 2026 catalogue references with each line's own price date. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.

No scheme is purchase-ready until the hallway is taped: the light switch position against the map and the wall lights, the corridor length, the dresser depth against the passage width, and the map's hanging height against the dresser top.

Hallway lighting is undecided (Ivan, 23 Oct): the picture-light bar (D), the woven wall lamps (E) and the gallery spots (F) are proposals; confirm a plug-in route from the outlet behind the dresser before ordering.
Pieces flagged "dims unpublished" or "partial" in the room placement report (the plant in E, the rug lengths) keep the layout size; measure them at the showroom before ordering.
Style renders are AI interpretations painted over the dimension-led model views; the supplier photo boards, the plan and the item schedule are the acceptance basis.

schemes.title: Harbour Grey
schemes.rationale: a light-grey lacquer double dresser with finely grooved handleless fronts on steel legs, a navy art-glass lamp, a chrome LED bar over the map as a picture light, a bold black-and-white rug and a slender grey-green tree: cool, crisp and the map's blues carried into the lamp
fit_notes: BoConcept Lugano 1540 x 480 x 930: the tallest top of the three, so the map's bottom edge at 1100 leaves a 170 mm reveal (photos up to 13 x 18 cm stand under it); raise the map 80 mm to 1180 if a 250 mm reveal matters more than the 1.1 m line.

The map (1040) is centred on the dresser (1540) with 250 mm of top free at each end; the chrome bar hangs about 120 mm above the map's top edge; the light switch stays about 120 mm beyond the dresser's living end.
Passage: 2300 (assumed) less 480 leaves about 1.82 m beside the dresser.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).

schemes.title: Conservatory Sage
schemes.rationale: the map wall painted soft sage, a smoked-oak shaker dresser with round knobs, a pair of woven sedge wall lamps flanking the map, an off-white rug with a fine green grid and a bird-of-paradise in the corner: a garden-room hallway where the map is framed by green
fit_notes: BLIMS Lauren 1500 x 450 x 850: top at 850 leaves the 250 mm reveal under the map; 230 mm of top free at each end of the map for frames and a bowl, no table lamp.

The woven wall lamps sit 150 mm outside the map's side edges, shades at 1.55 to 1.85 m; the left one stays 40 mm right of and 80 mm above the assumed switch plate, so the switch position must be taped before drilling.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).

schemes.title: Charcoal Gallery
schemes.rationale: the map wall painted deep charcoal, an espresso eight-drawer dresser with a reeded bottom row, an amber-glass cube lamp with a linen shade, two black gallery spots over the map, an off-white diamond-lattice rug and a tall black-framed mirror at the living end: the map lit like an exhibit
fit_notes: BLIMS Freya 1500 x 500 x 825: the lowest top gives a 275 mm reveal; the deepest dresser of the three, so 2300 (assumed) less 500 leaves about 1.80 m of passage.
The HOVET mirror (780 x 1960) leans at the living end of the plain wall, y 310 to 1090, more than 800 mm short of the switch; the two black spots sit above the map's top corners and aim down at it.
Conditional fit; hallway unmeasured: ceiling, corridor width and length, arches, window run and switch are accepted assumptions (ASSUMED.md).
